adjustment.analysis: Baseline median is 88.3. Father's Day (Sun) is a known driver, but past data shows only weak lift: x1.04 median, noise-adjusted x1.0. No price change (same as regular), so no price effect. Promotion history shows strong lifts (x2.09 avg), but no promotion this week. The 'ordinary week' after a promotion shows x0.79, but no prior promotion this week. Trend is downward (-25.8% over 13 weeks), but baseline already reflects this. No evidence of overstocking or supply issues. Classical model suggests no lift, consistent with weak historical signal. Adjust only for the weak event signal, shrunk to 1.0 due to low confidence and noise.
